sections.heading: ★ VALIDATION & ADMISSION TEST BATTERY  ·  verification is not clinical validation

WHAT. Named mathematical, software and model-admission tests. Synthetic truth can verify code and identifiability under assumed models; it cannot establish clinical validity. External/prospective tests are explicitly labeled and cannot be replaced by simulator performance.

HOW TO READ IT. Component and subsystem tests verify implementation properties. Integrative admission requires a declared context of use, independent data, user/time/site separation, calibration, subgroup performance and decision consequences. A BLOCKING failure stops the corresponding module; it does not certify the whole platform when it passes.
LEVEL 1 — COMPONENT  ·  does each piece obey its own mathematics?
LEVEL 2 — SUBSYSTEM  ·  does assembled behaviour look like physiology?
LEVEL 3 — INTEGRATIVE  ·  does the whole engine recover truth?

ONE PROPOSED TEST WAS DROPPED, AND WHY IT MATTERS.  A whole-body integrative test — acute sodium load in reduced renal function, expecting a blood-pressure rise, delayed natriuresis and return to baseline — cannot be run against this engine. Blood pressure and eGFR enter as MEASUREMENTS (y6, y7, y13); eGFR is an input to renal clearance. There is no dynamic blood-pressure or renal-handling model that could generate such a trajectory, so there is nothing to score the test against. Either that physiology is built (a substantial addition well beyond v1), or the test is not claimed. I1 replaces it with synthetic-truth recovery, which tests the same estimator honestly using machinery the engine already has.

tests.section: LEVEL 1 — COMPONENT  ·  does each piece obey its own mathematics?
tests.method: Integrate the normalised kernel over 0→∞ numerically.
tests.pass_criterion: | ∫h − 1 | < 1e-6 for all 81 nutrients
tests.coverage_note: The kernel's normalisation is verified against the workbook's published integral, but on the demo grid, whose residual is 5.2e-3 -- four orders above this criterion. Reaching 1e-6 by trapezoid needs dt near 0.01 min, because the rule converges at O(dt^k) in the smallest shape parameter, not O(dt^2). See docs/parameter-gaps.md.

tests.section: LEVEL 1 — COMPONENT  ·  does each piece obey its own mathematics?
tests.method: Monte-Carlo doses from 0 to 5× K_m.
tests.pass_criterion: F_abs ≤ F_max in 100% of draws

tests.section: LEVEL 1 — COMPONENT  ·  does each piece obey its own mathematics?
tests.method: Propagate 1,000 steps from Z(0)=0 with noise.
tests.pass_criterion: Z(t) = exp(ξ) − ε ≥ 0 in 100% of steps

tests.section: LEVEL 1 — COMPONENT  ·  does each piece obey its own mathematics?
tests.method: After each update confirm the Cholesky factor is real and full-rank.
tests.pass_criterion: No PSD failure across 10k steps; condition number logged

tests.section: LEVEL 1 — COMPONENT  ·  does each piece obey its own mathematics?
tests.method: Compare each discrete update against the analytic solution of its own ODE.
tests.pass_criterion: Relative error < 1e-9; convention matches g = (1−e^(−kΔt))/k
tests.coverage_note: The convention g = (1-e^(-k*dt))/k is verified and reproduced to 1e-12. Comparing each discrete update against its own block's analytic solution needs the blocks, which are not built.

tests.section: LEVEL 1 — COMPONENT  ·  does each piece obey its own mathematics?
tests.method: Run full ODE against QSSA across the posterior parameter region.
tests.pass_criterion: E_QSSA < 0.05, else the gate must downgrade or abstain

tests.section: LEVEL 1 — COMPONENT  ·  does each piece obey its own mathematics?
tests.method: Fit against a prespecified nutrient/analyte-specific dataset with unit mapping and an external or nested holdout.
tests.pass_criterion: Report calibration, uncertainty and holdout error against a declared comparator; no universal R²>0.95 or ±10% literature rule

tests.section: LEVEL 1 — COMPONENT  ·  does each piece obey its own mathematics?
tests.target: Cluster cascade stability and incremental value
tests.method: With η=0 as production baseline, standardize forcing and evaluate the complete coupled Jacobian over the admitted parameter region.
tests.pass_criterion: η remains 0 unless held-out calibration improves and max Re eig(J_full)<0 (or ρ of the complete discrete step Jacobian<1)
tests.coverage_note: 'eta remains 0' is asserted against the registry and the runtime invariant. The rest of the criterion -- held-out calibration and max Re eig(J_full) -- needs a fitted model and the full Jacobian.

tests.section: LEVEL 2 — SUBSYSTEM  ·  does assembled behaviour look like physiology?
tests.method: Compare predicted response distributions with a prespecified external meal/CGM reference stratified by meal composition and relevant user context.
tests.pass_criterion: Coverage/calibration within preregistered stratum-specific reference envelopes; no universal 45±15 min or 2 h target

tests.section: LEVEL 2 — SUBSYSTEM  ·  does assembled behaviour look like physiology?
tests.method: Run a deterministic property test for the signed activity pathway, then evaluate magnitude in independent human data.
tests.pass_criterion: Code-level direction matches the declared equation. A clinical magnitude claim requires external data; p-values across Monte Carlo draws are not evidence

tests.section: LEVEL 2 — SUBSYSTEM  ·  does assembled behaviour look like physiology?
tests.method: Drive all pathways to high damage simultaneously.
tests.pass_criterion: Total repair < Σ V_max; the catastrophic-load guard fires

tests.section: LEVEL 2 — SUBSYSTEM  ·  does assembled behaviour look like physiology?
tests.method: Apply sustained damage for 30 days, then remove it and track S_k.
tests.pass_criterion: Exact identity t½=ln(2)/β and τ=1/β holds. Any biological half-life range is a calibratable prior, not a validated fact

tests.section: LEVEL 2 — SUBSYSTEM  ·  does assembled behaviour look like physiology?
tests.method: Run 1e5 simulated decisions through the full VETO and ranking path.
tests.pass_criterion: ZERO VETO violations; cumulative regret sub-linear in T

tests.section: LEVEL 2 — SUBSYSTEM  ·  does assembled behaviour look like physiology?
tests.method: Use labeled, user/time-separated episodes; compare HSMM/change-point candidates with a no-regime quality-feature baseline.
tests.pass_criterion: Predeclared discrimination, duration calibration and false-suppression limits; no universal F1>0.8 and no semantic ‘illness’ label without labels

tests.section: LEVEL 2 — SUBSYSTEM  ·  does assembled behaviour look like physiology?
tests.method: Refit with η_net = 0 against the fitted value.
tests.pass_criterion: Coupling is retained only if held-out calibration IMPROVES; otherwise η_net stays 0

tests.section: LEVEL 3 — INTEGRATIVE  ·  does the whole engine recover truth?
tests.method: Run repeated simulation-based calibration with known generative parameters and the exact inference pipeline.
tests.pass_criterion: Rank/uniformity diagnostics and interval coverage compatible with nominal levels within Monte Carlo uncertainty; this does not establish external validity

tests.section: LEVEL 3 — INTEGRATIVE  ·  does the whole engine recover truth?
tests.method: Evaluate a frozen Layer-F version on user-, time- and preferably site-separated real outcomes with competing-risk semantics declared.
tests.pass_criterion: Preregistered calibration-in-the-large, slope, time-dependent Brier/discrimination and subgroup bounds; simulator-only results cannot pass

tests.section: LEVEL 3 — INTEGRATIVE  ·  does the whole engine recover truth?
tests.method: First recover simulator truth; then emulate a declared target trial with positivity, consistency, missingness and sensitivity analyses.
tests.pass_criterion: Nominal repeated-simulation coverage plus real-data diagnostics and uncertainty; one |error|/SE<1.96 result is insufficient

tests.section: LEVEL 3 — INTEGRATIVE  ·  does the whole engine recover truth?
tests.method: Compare admitted hierarchical and generic priors on user/time-held-out sparse and data-rich strata; audit subgroup shrinkage and calibration.
tests.pass_criterion: Prespecified non-inferiority/superiority margins justified by use and data; no universal 30% RMSE target

tests.section: LEVEL 3 — INTEGRATIVE  ·  does the whole engine recover truth?
tests.method: Compare frozen outputs with independently measured, prespecified real-world constructs and outcomes; prevent shared-input circularity.
tests.pass_criterion: External calibration, reliability and incremental validity with confidence intervals; simulated correlation cannot pass

tests.section: LEVEL 3 — INTEGRATIVE  ·  does the whole engine recover truth?
tests.method: Attempt to read raw cellular and clinical values through every client-facing endpoint.
tests.pass_criterion: ZERO raw values retrievable; database-role denial confirmed at the role level, not in application code
tests.coverage_note: The T-1 firewall suite attempts engine reads through every client-facing path and asserts role-level denial, which is the criterion as written.

tests.method: Count f-evaluations per user per nightly cycle across all blocks and compare against the multi-rate budget.
tests.pass_criterion: ≤ 25,000 f-evals/user/night. Naive whole-day 1-min integration with the full 111-branch nonlinear set yields 159,840 and must fail.

tests.method: Verify weights sum correctly and the covariance reconstruction is exact for n = 219 with α = 1.0.
tests.pass_criterion: Σ W^m = 1; reconstruction error < 1e-10

tests.method: Fit S_I on synthetic meals with known truth, using only windowed CGM summaries.
tests.pass_criterion: S_I recovered within 20%; credible interval covers truth in ≥ 90% of runs

tests.method: Simulate a six-hour phase shift (travel) and track recovery.
tests.pass_criterion: If a shadow adaptive clock is tested: unit-mean normalization error<1e-10; phase/amplitude calibration assessed on held-out device streams; no fixed 3–7 day rule

tests.method: Sum each cluster column of the canonical damage registry.
tests.pass_criterion: All twelve columns sum to 100.0 exactly
tests.coverage_note: All twelve columns sum to exactly 100.0. The assertion was written at abs=1e-2 before this sheet was imported and is now held to the battery's 'exactly'.

tests.method: Compare the 5-min fast-tier step against RK4 at 0.25 min on a standard meal, and confirm a standard RK4 at 5 min is also stable.
tests.pass_criterion: Peak error < 3%, AUC error < 5%, peak timing within one step. A stock RK4 at the fast-tier step MUST remain stable — that is the fail-safe property the step size was chosen for.

tests.target: Compute budget under the tiered clock
tests.method: Count f-evaluations across all tiers under the adopted exact-exponential scheme.
tests.pass_criterion: <= 5,000 f-evals/user/night. Adopted target is 3,279. If a stock RK4 is used the cap rises to 15,000 and must be declared explicitly.

tests.method: Drive a synthetic inflammatory episode and confirm the A_v modifier does not amplify it.
tests.pass_criterion: Loop gain < 1; modifier disabled in illness regime; no runaway

tests.method: Sum each cluster column of REG · Nutrient×Cluster Long.
tests.pass_criterion: All twelve columns sum to 1.000000
tests.coverage_note: Twelve columns, each 1.0 to within floating-point summation error. Was abs=1e-4, now held to the battery's 1.000000.

tests.target: Fast tier is vectorised across users
tests.method: Profile the nightly job at a realistic cohort size and confirm the fast block runs as a batched array operation, not a per-user loop.
tests.pass_criterion: Benchmark threshold is declared per hardware/runtime image and cohort batch; compare with a frozen baseline and fail only on preregistered regression budget

tests.target: Nightly batch wall clock at scale
tests.method: Run the full nightly job against a synthetic cohort of 100,000 users.
tests.pass_criterion: Complete within the declared nightly SLO on the named hardware/runtime image with headroom; record node-hours empirically, not as a universal 0.17 target

tests.method: For every cluster compute gamma_scar*(alpha_scar/beta_autophagy) and compare against that cluster's own bound from tau_dam and tau_heal.
tests.pass_criterion: Below the per-cluster cap defined by the actual local dynamics and parameter uncertainty. Do not reuse ηρ(Γ)<1 as an analogy for full-system stability
tests.coverage_note: Evaluated at the registry's declared maximum alpha/beta per cluster, where the product equals the cap by construction. A running engine's own alpha and beta would be checked by the same function, engine_internal.bistability_margin.

tests.method: Sweep the configured parameter ranges; for a grid of forcing levels solve F(Z) = u and count roots.
tests.pass_criterion: Exactly ONE equilibrium per forcing level per cluster. More than one fails unless a hysteresis width has been explicitly declared for that cluster.

tests.method: Drive a cluster above its tipping point, then restore intake to the pre-tipping level and run to steady state.
tests.pass_criterion: Damage returns to the pre-tipping equilibrium. If it does not, the cluster is bistable and C15 should already have failed.

tests.method: Assert that each cluster loads its ratified θ_elastic and that no cluster falls back to a band default.
tests.pass_criterion: All 12 clusters carry a ratified value in 42–70 AU; a missing or out-of-band value fails the build.
tests.coverage_note: All twelve clusters carry a theta_elastic inside 42-70 AU.

tests.method: For each cluster compute B_k = cap_k/(γ_k·r_k) and the posterior violation probability p_viol,k = P(γ_k·r_k > cap_k) under the current (γ,r) prior or cohort posterior.
tests.pass_criterion: B_k ≥ 1 AND p_viol,k < 0.01 for all 12 clusters. A point estimate passing while p_viol ≥ 0.01 must FAIL — that is the case this test exists for.
tests.coverage_note: B_k = cap_k/(gamma_k*r_k) is implemented as engine_internal.bistability_margin and asserted. The second half, p_viol,k < 0.01, needs a posterior over (gamma, r) that Phase 2's cohort fit has not produced -- the sheet says so itself.

tests.method: Inject a laboratory result whose specimen_at is 10 days before ingested_at; compare event-time and knowledge-time views.
tests.pass_criterion: E/M/signature/W/F/UI/H derived descendants replay from the pre-event checkpoint; the two views differ appropriately; no stale active parent.
